about_the_game:
The WWE 2K25 MyRISE Boost includes 200 Attribute Points to enhance your Superstar.

The MyRISE Boost is included as part of the Superstar Mega-Boost, and is one of the many items in WWE 2K25 Deadman and The Bloodline Editions.
